question: Which of the following Indian states has less sex ratio then combined sex ratio of India, according to 2011 census of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sex ratio of Gujarat is **919 females per 1000 males**, according to the 2011 Census of India.
 
• This is lower than the national average sex ratio of **943 females per 1000 males**.
 
• The sex ratio is an important indicator of gender equality in a region.
 
• Other states with low sex ratios include **Haryana (879 females per 1000 males)** and **Punjab (895 females per 1000 males)**.
 
• Gujarat
